title: Lanes cannot write or kill outside their worktree
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/sector-sweep-1119/report.md "S6 Harness & delivery".
Outcome: lane settings set permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_PROGRESS_SUMMARIES=1 after a one-lane A/B on tokens; a lane-scoped PreToolUse guard denies pkill/killall and git add -A/. outside the lane worktree; review rounds capped at 2. Routing inputs for t-qft76jx recorded there: fixed model per lane, escalate only on red CI/timeout, effort high never max (AA index: max 56 @ $44 vs high 58 @ $7.5).
Proof: `node --test test/hook/lane-guard.test.ts` passes, and lane settings contain blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories.
